chat.empty_state_desc: An advanced interface for working with local LLMs (Ollama) and OpenAI-compatible APIs. Create a new chat or select an existing one to get started.
chat.feature_1: Support for multiple providers (Ollama and OpenAI)
chat.feature_2: Interactive code widgets powered by Monaco Editor
chat.feature_4: Smart and flexible dialogue context management
chat.feature_5: Fully autonomous serverless operation on IndexedDB
chat.no_messages: Send a message to start the conversation.
chat.input_placeholder_continue: Last message is from you. Press Send or Enter to continue generation...
context.title: Context Management
context.toolhub_desc: When enabled, the agent can use ToolHub tools to solve complex tasks in real-time.
context.sliding_window_desc: When the limit is exceeded, the oldest messages in this chat will be automatically deleted.
context.confirm_keep_last: Are you sure you want to keep only the last {count} messages and delete all older ones?
context.confirm_delete_first: Are you sure you want to delete the first {count} messages?
context.confirm_delete_heavy: Are you sure you want to delete the {count} heaviest messages by token count?
context.confirm_compress_code: Are you sure you want to compress all code blocks in this chat? All code blocks will be replaced with "[CODE REMOVED TO SAVE CONTEXT]". This action is irreversible.
settings.title: Developer Studio Settings
settings.add_provider_desc: Configure connection to Ollama (local) or OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter).
settings.strip_latest_desc: Strip :latest suffix from model names in requests (useful for load balancers)
settings.no_providers: LLM providers are not configured yet. Add one above.
settings.global_system_prompt_desc: This prompt will be added as a 'system' instruction at the beginning of each request to the LLM.
settings.max_loops_desc: Maximum number of tool call cycles per request. Prevents infinite generation loops.
settings.tokenizer_algo_desc: Select the tokenizer matching your model for accurate context calculation and sliding window operation.
settings.font_size_desc: Select a comfortable font size for reading messages and code in the chat area.
settings.collapse_tool_steps: Collapse tool call chains by default
settings.collapse_tool_steps_desc: If enabled, ToolHub execution chains will be automatically hidden under a spoiler. You can expand them with a single click.
settings.backup_desc: Export all chat history, chats, and provider settings to a JSON file for backup or transfer to another device.
settings.language_desc: Select your preferred language for the application interface.
settings.confirm_import: Warning! Importing a backup will completely overwrite the current database (all chats, messages, and providers). Continue?
settings.import_error: Import error: Invalid backup file format. ({error})
sidebar.no_chats: No active chats. Click "New Chat" to start talking.
sidebar.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this chat and all its messages?
banner.text: Developing this project solo, sharing behind-the-scenes, failures, and AI thoughts in my Telegram channel. Even if channel is in russian - I will translate your suggestions from any language.
